grammarFocus: was / were；常用过去式入门；be going to；because；基础句型综合复习。
title: Mei's Busy Week
instructions: 听录音，完成8个问题。每题只选一个答案或填空。填空答案必须来自录音原文，且不超过字数限制。所有题目基于模拟教学材料，不是官方考试。
transcript: Mei: Hi, Tom. I was at the farm last Saturday. I was very tired. Tom: Was it fun? Mei: Yes, it was fun. We helped animals. We fed chickens. Tom: Were you happy? Mei: Yes, I was happy. But I was tired because I worked a lot. Tom: What are you going to do next Saturday? Mei: I am going to visit my cousin. She is going to come to my house. Tom: Are you going to cook? Mei: Yes, I am going to cook noodles because my cousin likes noodles. Tom: That sounds nice. Mei: Thank you. I am going to buy some eggs because we need eggs for noodles.

questions.explanation: 录音中Mei说“I was at the farm last Saturday.”，所以她在农场。
questions.evidence: I was at the farm last Saturday.

questions.explanation: 录音中Mei说“I was very tired.”，所以她感觉很累。

questions.prompt: Mei上周六帮助了什么？请填一个词。
questions.explanation: 录音中Mei说“We helped animals.”，所以答案是animals。
录音中Mei说“I was tired because I worked a lot.”，所以她累是因为工作了很多。
questions.evidence: I was tired because I worked a lot.

questions.explanation: 录音中Mei说“I am going to visit my cousin.”，所以她打算拜访表妹。
questions.evidence: I am going to visit my cousin.

questions.prompt: Mei的表妹打算来谁的家？请填一个词。
questions.explanation: 录音中Mei说“She is going to come to my house.”，所以表妹来的是Mei的家，填my。
questions.evidence: She is going to come to my house.

options: 因为她的表妹喜欢面条
answers: 因为她的表妹喜欢面条
questions.explanation: 录音中Mei说“I am going to cook noodles because my cousin likes noodles.”，所以她做面条是因为表妹喜欢。
questions.evidence: I am going to cook noodles because my cousin likes noodles.

questions.explanation: 录音中Mei说“I am going to buy some eggs because we need eggs for noodles.”，所以买鸡蛋是因为做面条需要。
questions.evidence: I am going to buy some eggs because we need eggs for noodles.

grammar.title: 过去时与将来计划
grammar.explanation: 我们用 was/were 表示过去的状态，用动词过去式（如 helped, fed）表示过去的动作。用 be going to 表示计划或打算。because 用来给出原因。
grammar.example: I was tired because I worked a lot.

options: I was at the farm yesterday.
I were at the farm yesterday.
I am at the farm yesterday.
answers: I was at the farm yesterday.
questions.explanation: 主语是I，过去时用was，所以第一句正确。
questions.evidence: I was at the farm last Saturday.

questions.explanation: 过去时用动词过去式helped，所以第一句正确。

options: I am going to cook noodles.
I am go to cook noodles.
answers: I am going to cook noodles.
questions.explanation: be going to 结构需要be动词，所以第一句正确。
questions.evidence: I am going to cook noodles.

options: I am happy because I worked a lot.
I am happy so I worked a lot.
I am happy but I worked a lot.
answers: I am happy because I worked a lot.
questions.explanation: because 表示原因，所以第一句正确。
questions.evidence: I was tired because I worked a lot.

part1: What did you do last weekend?
What are you going to do next weekend?
Why are you going to do that?
speaking.part2: Describe a plan for next weekend. You should say: where you are going to go, who you are going to go with, what you are going to do, and why you are going to do it.
part3: Do you like to make plans?
Are you going to cook this week?

transfer.writing: 写2-4个简单的句子，谈谈你上周末做了什么，以及下周末打算做什么。用上 was/were, 过去式动词, be going to, because。
